_about: The level switcher at the top of the flashcard, grammar and game lists. Each item has the level where it is first taught (1 = Latin I … 4 = Latin IV); choosing a level shows everything up to and including it, so Latin II shows Latin I and II content. Flashcard keys are deck ids, or deck/view for one view of a deck. Add "only": true to show an item at its own level alone (the vocabulary lists). A deck can also narrow itself at lower levels with 'links': the extra link settings used at that level (same as a link preset, e.g. mood=ind). Anything not listed shows at every level.
_banners: One banner per level, shown full-width above the flashcard, grammar and game lists when that level is chosen (including when embedded on the Google Site; not for All levels, and not when the link adds ?banner=0). file = img/banners/<file>.webp (plus <file>-800.webp for phones); focus = the part of the painting kept in view when the banner crops it (CSS object-position, x% y%).
